ja: 理由を　思い出しました。

key: TAKA: Do we realllly have to do this again?
en: TAKA: Do we realllly have to do this again?
ja: タカ: 本当に　また　これを　やらなきゃ　いけないんですか?
タカ: 今　思い出しました。

key: When I was young, my father took me here with him once.
en: When I was young, my father took me here with him once.
ja: 子どもの頃　一度　父に　ここへ　連れてこられたことが　あります。

key: It was before he really got involved starting Team Meteor.
en: It was before he really got involved starting Team Meteor.
ja: 父が　本格的に　メテオ団を　始める前の　ことでした。

key: We explored these ruins together looking for something...
en: We explored these ruins together looking for something...
ja: 一緒に　何かを　探しに　この遺跡を　探検したんです……

key: To be honest, it's one of the very few positive memories I actually have of him...
en: To be honest, it's one of the very few positive memories I actually have of him...
ja: 正直　父についての　数少ない良い思い出の　一つなんです……

key: ...But I feel uneasy about this room.
en: ...But I feel uneasy about this room.
ja: ……でも　この部屋には　どこか　不安を　感じます。

key: I can't remember why, but I feel like we should be careful.
en: I can't remember why, but I feel like we should be careful.
ja: 理由は　思い出せませんが　気をつけたほうが　いい気が　します。
